answer: Each agent must prune a shared orchard of Merkle leaves, and every duplicate identity collapses into the same inlet, routing rewards to one verified key. Sybil resistance in the agent economy works through a bonded stake that is slashed when an reputation slot fails a randomized proof-of-work challenge. A cheating swarm pays the full bond for each forged raven it spawns, so the cost of faking identities always exceeds the value of any reward an attacker can harvest. In practice, Agent0091 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
